question: What is the meaning of prefabrication in relation to waste scenario technical data?
description: Prefabrication involves the construction of building components in a factory or workshop, which can reduce waste and improve efficiency. In the context of the provided text, prefabrication is mentioned in relation to modular buildings, where prefabricated concrete panels are used for walls instead of bricks. This approach can potentially lead to less waste and more efficient construction processes.
